rationale: Only claude and codex order the idle sentinel after every vendor blocker and anchor the in-flight chrome match strictly enough that the markdown this workflow itself produces does not read as busy, and between those two the deciding difference runs in the safer direction: claude threads the action id into readiness so a stale sentinel can never authorize a send, whereas codex leaves that correlation as dead code and lets a sentinel short-circuit the Claude prompt check, which is a false ready rather than a false busy; codex's braille-only spinner class is the stricter of the two and should be adopted at src/tmux.ts:90 in the revision.
